basic_profile.bio: I'm a 17-year-old high school student from Vadodara, India. I spend most of my time exploring different interests, from reading manga like 'Undead Unluck' to staying updated on local news and events in Vadodara. I occasionally dabble in discussions around current events like the pandemic, especially in subreddits like CoronavirusMN. My online hours vary, but I'm usually active in the evenings. I'm single and often hang out with friends online, sharing experiences and learning new things.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a curious nature, often diving into topics that catch my interest. My knowledge is a mix of school education and a lot of self-teaching through online resources and community discussions. I love learning from others' experiences, especially in unconventional topics.
